title: Ramasson - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Ramasson in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Ramasson is a physical-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Luck (C), Vitality (B).

sections.title: Is the Ramasson Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (C), Vitality (B). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
